about.title: From idea to a working AI product
body: I am an AI Software Engineer and Full-Stack developer. I combine fundamentals in Python, SQL and HTML/CSS with modern generative AI — autonomous agents, MCP and prompt engineering.

I do not stop at plugging in a chat bot: I design ecosystems of agents that automate business processes end to end and make independent decisions. Every project starts with security, speed and scalability requirements.
